groups.problem: Global fine-grained VIEW grants bypass client-specific VIEW denials in client viewing and listing.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same short-circuit in canView(ClientModel) and the same listing consequence, requesting that client-specific permissions take precedence over global grants.

groups.problem: Javadoc on void require-methods incorrectly describes a boolean return value instead of guard behavior.
groups.rationale: The same documentation mistake appears on requireView() and requireViewClientScopes(); each needs its own edit using the same guard-documentation approach.
